utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Ira, what kind of repairs are we talking about for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly small stuff—patching cracks, tightening the loose boards, and fixing the lights. I heard they’re keeping it pretty practical this time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—how many people do they need, and when are they starting?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with the repair drive. What tools do you need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I think we need a wrench set and maybe some screwdrivers. I’ll check the list and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah—just let me know when you’ve got the list and I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive got a good bit of support already. If you’re heading over, I can tell you who’s still collecting donations.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess. If you could tell me who’s still collecting, I’d appreciate it—I just want to make sure I plan the route right.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I know Mara by the corner shop and Leon over on Cedar are still taking donations. If you want, I can point out the quickest route between them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just let me know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—could you check which items are still needed and where to drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll check the list and find the drop-off spot, then get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive already — it’s a great chance to pitch in. If you want, I can help spread the word a bit more.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll mention it to a few more neighbors today and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo — I’ve got the repair drive on my list and I’m keeping everything organized. Let me know what you need from me first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Just let me know what tools are already set aside, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve set aside the hammer, screwdriver set, wrench, tape measure, and some extra nails. If you need anything else, just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the exact repair drive details before I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure of the exact details yet—I joined a bit late. Want me to check with the others and get back to you?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please check with the others and let me know the exact details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule if you tell me when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I don’t have the exact time nailed down yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I do so you can help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about it. What’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—people are dropping off tools and a few folks already signed up to help. I can fill you in on the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That would be great—thanks. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just tell me where to drop it off and when.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great—can you confirm you’ll bring it by Saturday morning, around 10?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, Saturday morning around 10 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is happening soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey. I could use help sorting the tool boxes and maybe carrying a few things over if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that. Just tell me when to come by and what time you’re starting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll mention the repair drive to everyone I see and keep the reminder going.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — that’ll really help keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep bringing it up whenever I bump into folks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s picking up speed—what do you still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I could still use a hand sorting the donated tools and checking what’s already been claimed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help sort the tools and make a claimed pile so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive—thanks for the reminder. I’m happy to help out however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Oren—I’ll let everyone know you’re in. We’re still pulling things together for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—just point me to whatever needs doing, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit behind on that; what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s still going on, but we need a few more tools and parts. I can swing by later and check what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo. I’d appreciate that—just let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand. What do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thanks, Gus. I just need help sorting the tools and loading them into the truck, around 9 tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll be there at 9 to help sort the tools and load the truck.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing, and where can I pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, wonderful—thank you! We still need a few folks to sort donations and help with setup at the community center; if you’re free, I can put your name down.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, please put my name down for both—I'll help sort donations and with setup at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it should really help folks out. Let me know if you want me to spread the word to my side of the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Jules—could you let people know to drop off repairs at the community center by Saturday afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and make sure folks know to drop repairs at the community center by Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—we can get the repair drive organized and keep it running smoothly. Tell me what you need first, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—do we have enough gloves, tape, and flashlights to start with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll check our supplies right away and let you know what we’re short on. If we’re low, I can put out a quick call for more before we start.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on that repair drive yet. What’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re still collecting tools and supplies, and the biggest need right now is volunteers for Saturday. Can you help with that?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can help on Saturday. Just tell me what time and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, I’m a bit swamped—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries—just let me know if you can help by dropping off supplies or giving me a hand after school.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can drop off some supplies after work, but I probably can’t stay long after school.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help out with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam—can you confirm you’re actually available this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m available this Saturday and can help with the repair drive.
